info.title: ACTUAL synthetic Career API
info.description: Isolated local synthetic development only. No authentication or real-data access. All mutations require the current aggregate generation. Synthetic source and claim reviews are separate operations; independent verification and external submission are not API operations.

get.description: Read current jobs, profile/evidence, CV metadata and application histories.

post.description: Initialize the configured synthetic workspace with its first manual job.
Paste a manual job; source references are metadata and are never fetched.

get.description: List current jobs in stable typed-ID order; each page identifies its generation.
Inspect claim/evidence state without retrieving the complete career snapshot.

post.description: Record a self-reported claim; callers cannot assign review or verification state.

get.description: Read current declarations, source reviews, support and conflicts separately.

post.description: Attach an unreviewed source to an unreviewed, material-independent claim.
Review an exact synthetic fixture source; this does not accept its claims.
Accept a pinned claim only against sufficient current reviewed synthetic support.
Retain a withdrawn source and atomically invalidate dependent claim support.
Start preparing; supplied history and initial later states are forbidden.
Append a valid reported status; this neither reviews content nor submits externally.

get.description: Read retained observations ordered by occurrence and event ID.

AssessmentCounts.title: AssessmentCounts
AssessmentCounts.description: Bounded requirement-category counts, never a fit or hiring score.

limitation.title: Limitation
limitation.default: Coverage counts only supported selected units; no overall fit score. Unverified user claims are excluded from prepared factual materials. Synthetic reviews do not verify a real person.

ClaimDeclaration.title: ClaimDeclaration
ClaimDeclaration.description: A source-attributed structured declaration, not certified prose.

EvidenceBackedProfileView.title: EvidenceBackedProfileView
EvidenceBackedProfileView.description: Synthetic support snapshot. References do not authenticate real-world facts.

ExperienceContext-Input.title: ExperienceContext
ExperienceContext-Input.description: Explicit source metadata. Missing activity dates remain missing.

ExperienceContext-Output.title: ExperienceContext
ExperienceContext-Output.description: Explicit source metadata. Missing activity dates remain missing.

ExperienceEvidenceView.title: ExperienceEvidenceView
ExperienceEvidenceView.description: Explicit context is bound to its source review, never a tenure total.

JobFitAssessment.title: JobFitAssessment
JobFitAssessment.description: Revalidate against current sources before reuse; no storage/event authority.

Requirement.title: Requirement
Requirement.description: A normalized proposal; a valid schema never proves accurate extraction.

RequirementConstraints.title: RequirementConstraints
RequirementConstraints.description: Only explicit syntax is recorded; this structure does not establish support.

RequirementLike.title: InterpretedRequirement
RequirementLike.description: Atomic source identity and conservative interpretation, never domain truth.

ReviewSyntheticClaim.title: ReviewSyntheticClaim
ReviewSyntheticClaim.description: Explicitly accept a claim against its current reviewed synthetic sources.

ReviewSyntheticEvidence.title: ReviewSyntheticEvidence
ReviewSyntheticEvidence.description: Review one existing synthetic fixture, never certify an imported source.

WithdrawEvidence.title: WithdrawEvidence
WithdrawEvidence.description: Withdraw one current source and reconcile its exact dependent claim refs.
